text:
Alder is a retrieval method built on the Birch model.
Alder uses the Lumen reranker.
Alder targets evidence retrieval.
title: Alder technical note

text:
Birch (also called Base) is a language model evaluated on the Cedar dataset.
Birch is evaluated using the Accuracy metric.
Birch uses the Quartz encoder.
title: Birch technical note

text:
Cedar is a dataset for question answering.
Cedar contains 1200 examples.
Cedar reports the Accuracy metric.
title: Cedar technical note

text:
Drift is a retrieval method built on the Elm model.
Drift uses the Lumen reranker.
Drift targets evidence retrieval.
title: Drift technical note

text:
Elm (also called Base) is a language model evaluated on the Fern dataset.
Elm is evaluated using the F1 metric.
Elm uses the Quartz encoder.
title: Elm technical note

text:
Fern is a dataset for question answering.
Fern contains 800 examples.
Fern reports the F1 metric.
title: Fern technical note

text:
Lumen is a reranker evaluated on the Cedar dataset.
Lumen uses the Quartz encoder.
Lumen targets evidence retrieval.
Cedar reports the Accuracy metric.
title: Lumen technical note

text:
Quartz (QZ) is an encoder evaluated on the Slate dataset.
Slate is a dataset for semantic similarity.
Quartz is evaluated using the Spearman metric.
title: Quartz technical note
